item.title: State workers and retirees launch 'Scrap the Cap' campaign against proposed health insurance cost shifts
item.description: Kentucky state employees and retirees are pushing back against a provision in the General Assembly's proposed state budget that would cap the state's contribution to workers' health insurance plans.

item.title: Man indicted for 2019 murder of Kentucky mother whose body was found dumped on roadside
item.description: Ryan "Todd" Crawley, who previously pleaded guilty to evidence tampering and abuse of a corpse, has now been indicted on murder charges by a Scott County grand jury.

item.title: Teen killed in afternoon crash on Beechtree Pike in Fleming County
item.description: A 19-year-old is dead following an afternoon vehicle collision on Beechtree Pike in Fleming County, the Fleming County Sheriff reports.
